    <h2>Daniel He, PhD</h2>
    <p>Daniel He, PhD, is the founder of Clinical Statistics Notes, an independent knowledge-sharing platform focused on practical clinical research. He created the site to provide clear and accessible resources on clinical trial data, CDISC standards, statistical programming, biostatistics, and real-world evidence. His goal is to make complex statistical and programming concepts easier to understand and apply through practical notes, examples, and reusable resources.</p>
